purpose: Mate the exact EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 plus ER-TPC035-6 configured assembly to the unchanged 40-contact main-board interface while keeping the panel connector and any future panel-only rework on a small replaceable adapter.

board.datum: top-left in the UI-inner placement frame

components.role: exact plug for the selected 2.0-mm stack
dual-contact 50-position ZIF for the exact 0.30-mm EastRising tail

electrical.signal_contract: the adapter is passive copper: it remaps the existing 40-contact board interface to the exact 50-contact panel, fans out required power/ground ties and leaves manufacturer NC/SDO contacts open
electrical.recovery_mode: deliberate strap change to ILI9488 4-wire serial; no QSPI claim
electrical.h2_rule: H2 rewires the main connector nets to this accepted map; the superseded 40-to-40 HMX route is not a valid schematic source after H1-R2.35

orientation.panel_rule: mount the configured panel with its folded FPC toward the antenna edge, as on ESP32-DIV, so the tail never enters the LED, navigation or function-key zone
orientation.display_memory_transform: rotate ILI9488 output by 180 degrees relative to its cable-down native orientation
orientation.touch_transform: rotate FT6236 coordinates by 180 degrees before UI hit-testing
orientation.tail_contract: manufacturer drawing controls the 50-contact 0.50-mm-pitch, 0.30-mm-stiffened folded tail; H5 incoming inspection verifies only lot conformity and insertion, not an unknown geometry

paper_checks.incremental_adapter_pcb_cost: factory RFQ required; no purchase authorized

evidence.finding: EastRising controls the 50-contact 0.50-mm tail, complete CTP outline, 8080-8 strap and every LCD/touch/backlight contact.
Exact ER-TFT035IPS-6 is in stock; configured ER-TPC035-6 capacitive-touch-controller option is orderable at quantity one.
FH34SRJ-50S-0.5SH(50) is exact HRS original-manufacturer C3169104, Extended SMT, Economic/Standard PCBA, MOQ 1 and live stock.
DF40C(2.0)-40DS-0.4V(51) controls the fixed 2.0-mm main-board receptacle stack.
DF40C-40DP-0.4V(51) is the exact 40-position mating plug.

release_boundary: H1 freezes the 30.5x12.0-mm antenna-edge adapter bay, exact ER-TFT035IPS-6 plus ER-TPC035-6 panel stack, C3169104 panel mate, passive 40-to-50 electrical map and cable-to-antenna orientation. H2 imports the exact footprints and rewires the superseded display sheet; H5 confirms current-lot conformity and written factory acceptance for adhesive placement, FPC insertion and one-prototype final mating.
